description: Na₄Mg(FeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.51 Å. Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.04 Å) and two longer (2.07 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FeO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are two shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (2.05 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.89 Å) and two longer (1.97 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and two Fe atoms to form distorted ONa₂MgFe₂ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgFe₂ square pyramid, corners with six equivalent ONa₂MgFe tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe₂ square pyramid, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom to form ONa₂MgFe tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgFe tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ square pyramids, corners with four equivalent ONa₂MgFe tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent ONa₂MgFe₂ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids.
